mod.help:
🤖 *Moderation commands*

• `!mod enable <feature>`
Turn a feature on (antilink, antispam, forbiddenwords)

• `!mod disable <feature>`
Turn a feature off.

• `!mod action <feature> <DELETE|WARN|KICK>`
Set the feature action (antiSpam: WARN|KICK).

• `!mod status`
Show which features are on.

• `!mod words add <word>`
Add a forbidden word.

• `!mod words remove <word>`
Remove a forbidden word.

• `!mod words list`
List the forbidden words.
